items.name: a book
items.description: Bound pages. Still legible in places.

items.name: dried provisions
items.eat_message: Dry and tasteless. It does what it needs to.
items.description: A cloth parcel of preserved travel rations. Salt-stiff, dense, neutral. Someone prepared this for a journey they did not finish.

items.name: water skin
items.drink_message: Cold and flat. The thirst retreats.
items.description: A leather skin, filled with water. The hide is old but the stitching holds. Something alive is in it still.

items.name: a book
items.description: Bound pages. Still legible in places.

items.name: a letter
items.description: Folded paper. Someone meant to send this.

items.name: stone inscription
items.description: A heavy inscribed fragment. Broken from something larger.

items.name: Crow Bile
items.description: A small dark sac. What the crow has processed through it is unclear. The fluid inside is extremely bitter and faintly luminous.

items.name: sulphur cap fragment
items.eat_message: Bitter. Leaves a faint chemical taste at the back of the throat.
items.description: A wedge of orange fungus cut from the cap. The bitter oil beneath is the useful part. The smell lingers on the hands for days.

items.name: prophet's eye cap
items.eat_message: Tasteless. Something shifts at the edge of sight for a moment, then is gone.
items.description: A pale, watery mushroom cap. The alchemists prized it. The cap alone is worthless — the liquid inside is what they wanted.

items.name: Crow Jerky
items.description: Strips of dried crow meat. It tastes exactly as you would expect. It sustains you regardless.
